disclosure_regime.note: Revenue is published as a discrete quarter every quarter, with brand, channel, geography and segment splits for that quarter alone. A complete income statement is published twice a year, at H1 and at the full year, so the second half is never a published period.
disclosure_regime.quarterly_floor_reason: The company completed its NYSE listing on 2021-12-17 and published no quarterly figure before that. Each 2021 quarter reaches this page as the prior-year column of a 2022 release.

brand.other_basis_note: `other` is the line as the Q1 2024 release and everything after it define it. The company folded two rows into it without saying so in words: Agnona at the Q1 2023 release and Third Party Brands at the Q1 2024 release. Earlier quarters here are the sum of the rows as first printed, and that sum equals the folded line the company printed itself in every period where both exist -- seven for the Third Party Brands fold, two for Agnona. See `fold_overlap`.
brand.tff_floor_reason: Tom Ford International was consolidated from 2023-04-29.

fold_overlap.note: The `Other` product line absorbed two rows without a word of explanation: Agnona at the Q1 2023 release and Third Party Brands at the Q1 2024 release. Each block lists the periods printed on both sides of its fold, so the sum can be checked rather than taken on trust.

channel.wholesale_basis_note: `wholesale_branded` covers the three brands only. The releases up to Q4 2022 print a `Total Wholesale` that also carries Textile, Third Party Brands and Agnona; those quarters are the sum of the brand rows the same releases print beside it.

geography.basis_note: The Q1 2024 release replaced EMEA / North America / Latin America / APAC with EMEA / Americas / Greater China Region / Rest of APAC. Quarters before it are restated here by the only arithmetic that fits: Americas = North America + Latin America, Rest of APAC = APAC - Greater China Region. Seven periods are printed on both bases and the identity holds to the euro in all of them.
geography.of_which_floor_note: Italy, the United States and Japan were `of which` rows under the old geography table and stop with it at 2023Q4.

basis_overlap.note: Every period both taxonomies were printed for, each basis as printed. The page restates the earlier quarters onto the current four regions by Americas = North America + Latin America and Rest of APAC = APAC - Greater China Region. These rows are what makes that checkable instead of asserted.

half_story.source: 2026 年半年报（6-K，2026-09-03，zgn-20260630.htm）。两个变动额是公司自己写在正文里的：「Financial income and expenses」段落的 a negative impact of €14,582 thousand from the fair value remeasurement of liabilities for put options held by non-controlling interests，与「Foreign exchange」段落的 unfavorable foreign exchange impacts of €17,252 thousand relating to the Thom Browne non-controlling interest put option liability。负债余额与两档行权条款取自附注 16；实际税率与不可抵扣的说明取自所得税段落。
half_story.fair_value_scope: €14,582 千是全部少数股东看跌期权负债的公允价值变动之差；公司写明 primarily driven by Thom Browne non-controlling interests，并给出 Thom Browne 本期亏 €1,056 千、上年同期赚 €13,835 千。汇兑那一项只属于 Thom Browne 那笔以美元计价的负债。

stores.note: Directly operated stores and wholesale doors at each period end, as the release covering that period prints them. Only the current-period block of each table is read: the comparative blocks carry a different number of brand columns whenever TOM FORD FASHION did not yet exist at that date.

net_financial_position.sign_note: Positive is net financial indebtedness; negative is a net cash surplus.

restatements.identity: Americas = North America + Latin America; Rest of APAC = APAC - Greater China Region
restatements.note: The Q1 2024 revenue release swapped four region rows for four different ones and restated the comparative quarter, with no sentence anywhere saying what changed. Seven periods were printed on both bases and the two arithmetic identities above close to the euro in all seven, which is the only evidence that they are the same revenue cut differently.
Agnona was disposed of and its stub row folded into Other.

Third Party Brands was its own row through the FY2023 release and is inside Other from the Q1 2024 release. Seven periods print the line on both sides of the fold, and old Other plus Third Party Brands equals the new Other in every one. The figures are in `quarterly.brand.fold_overlap`.

The only restatement the company explains. Zegna segment revenue falls and the elimination line rises by the same amount in both quarters, so the group total does not move. Q4 2023 as the company prints it equals FY2023 minus the *restated* nine months: subtracting the nine months as first published would put Q4 2023 EUR 12,826 thousand too low.

There was no Corporate line at all until the FY2022 results release and the FY2022 20-F; corporate costs sat inside the Zegna segment. Three periods were published on both bases -- FY2020, FY2021 and H1 2022 -- and in each one the difference is exactly the Corporate line that the later filing introduced. 111,018 and 91,385 are printed in the FY2021 20-F; 131,929 and 20,911 appear nowhere in it. H1 2021 exists only on the old basis.

The FY2021 figures were labelled preliminary. The FY2022 release and the FY2022 20-F move EUR 1,191 thousand of FY2021 revenue out of wholesale and into Other: that is the Agnona product line, whose business was deconsolidated in January 2021 and whose 2021 revenue the FY2021 20-F states as EUR 1,191 thousand. The group total is the same on both bases.

Through the FY2022 20-F the income statement was presented by nature -- raw materials, personnel, depreciation -- with no cost-of-sales and no gross-profit line at all. The string 'gross profit' occurs zero times in the FY2021 20-F. The FY2023 filing switched to presentation by function and restated 2021 and 2022 to match, which is the only place those years' gross profit exists. Operating profit, profit before taxes, tax and profit are identical on both presentations. So on this page the gross-profit line for FY2021, FY2022 and H1 2022 is a restated comparative, not a figure those periods' own reports printed, and 2021H1 has no gross profit at all.

republication_census.note: Every period that more than one release printed, counted per line. `republished` is how many periods a later release printed again; `changed` is how many of those came back with a different number.

medium_term_targets.reaffirmation_note: The H1 2025 release (2025-09-05, chairman's quote: “we remain on track to achieve our 2027 targets”) and the FY2025 release (2026-03-20, Outlook: “remains focused on delivering on its 2027 targets”) refer to the set published with the FY2024 results on 2025-03-27, which replaced the 2023-12-05 CAGR targets. Neither restates a number. The H1 2026 results release (2026-09-03) and the H1 2026 semi-annual report do not mention the targets at all; the “lower end” wording quoted in the local analysis comes from the conference calls, not from a filing.
